inspiration.observed_pattern: A derived ROW_NUMBER partition is filtered to one selected rank and persisted through an INSERT ... SELECT duplicate-key refresh.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two divisions, two existing rank checkpoints, and one new rank-one checkpoint while retaining the partitioned window, derived filter, ordered insert source, and multiple duplicate-key assignments.

fixture_notes: Division 71's two existing rank checkpoints are stale and must refresh; division 72 has no checkpoint and must be inserted by the same statement.
determinism_notes: Two divisions, fixed participant scores, selected ranks one and two, and ordered final rows; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE division_scores_min (score_id INT PRIMARY KEY, division_id INT NOT NULL, participant_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE division_checkpoints_min (division_id INT NOT NULL, rank_no INT NOT NULL, participant_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (division_id, rank_no))

steps.sql: INSERT INTO division_checkpoints_min (division_id, rank_no, participant_id, score) SELECT ranked.division_id, ranked.rank_no, ranked.participant_id, ranked.score FROM (SELECT division_id, participant_id, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division_id ORDER BY score DESC, participant_id ASC) AS rank_no FROM division_scores_min) AS ranked WHERE ranked.rank_no IN (1, 2) ORDER BY ranked.division_id, ranked.rank_no ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE participant_id = VALUES(participant_id), score = VALUES(score)

checks.sql: SELECT division_id, rank_no, participant_id, score FROM division_checkpoints_min ORDER BY division_id, rank_no
